title: CQL-to-ELM Compilation Pipeline
description: Read one define statement as authored CQL and as compiled ELM, then watch a reasoning engine evaluate it against two patients with opposite results.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clinical Quality Language
Expression Logical Model
clinical reasoning
quality measures
FHIR

educational.audience: Undergraduate students and healthcare data practitioners
learningObjectives: Given a CQL define statement, the learner can explain each stage of its compilation into ELM and translate between the CQL authoring format and its corresponding ELM fragment.
